name: campus-connect
description: DMI Campus Connect — College ERP and Learning Management Portal

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @campus-connect/api & npm run dev --workspace @campus-connect/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/contracts && npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/api && npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/contracts && npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/contracts && npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @campus-connect/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @campus-connect/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @campus-connect/ui
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @campus-connect/contracts && npm run test --workspace @campus-connect/api && npm run test --workspace @campus-connect/web
